notes: Convert Physical Media and Mover from closeable overlays into full Rip Manager pages that retain the shared application header.
Add /physical-media and /mover routes with browser Back and Forward support, Dashboard navigation and a clear active-page state.
Make the Rip Manager logo force-refresh the HTML, JavaScript and CSS assets as the touch-friendly equivalent of Ctrl+F5.
Add Mover & storage to the main Settings control centre with every new queue, Byte-Me destination and Rip Node access variable.
Keep mover configuration in one place by removing the separate settings button and form from the live Mover page.
Validate mover paths and media folder mappings when they are saved from the main Settings screen, and wake the mover immediately after a settings change.
Remove the duplicate Mover button from the main header; Mover is now available only from the burger-menu popup.
Show only physical-media records whose real folder currently exists on Byte-Me or the mounted Rip Node share, instead of displaying the full database history.
Keep current rips visible as soon as their output folder is created on the node.
Move Mover into its own main-menu option and add editable Movies, TV, Music and Audiobooks paths beneath the /media share.
Populate the documented rip-node-1 mount mapping for existing v0.21.0 installations that still have the untouched empty mapping.
Keep the v0.21.0 photo, editable details, Byte-Me scanner and safe single-folder mover features, with Rip Node remaining at v0.2.9.
